meta.aiUse: Built by pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code), directed and reviewed by the team. See AI_USE.md.

grid.order: north to south, then west to east

factors.label: Slope
factors.source: LRO LOLA gridded elevation model LDEM_64 (NASA PDS Geosciences Node, LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0; Smith et al. 2010)
factors.note: 55.6 km square window centred on the cell centre, posts of 474 m (LOLA 64 pixels per degree), pipeline/terrain_metrics.py: the method used for the targets and for Earth. Towards the poles neighbouring windows overlap.

factors.label: Roughness
factors.source: LRO LOLA gridded elevation model LDEM_64 (NASA PDS Geosciences Node, LRO-L-LOLA-4-GDR-V1.0; Smith et al. 2010)
factors.note: 55.6 km square window centred on the cell centre, posts of 474 m (LOLA 64 pixels per degree), pipeline/terrain_metrics.py: the method used for the targets and for Earth. Towards the poles neighbouring windows overlap.

factors.label: Mean surface temperature
factors.source: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Products, PDS LRO-L-DLRE-5-GCP-V1.0 (Williams et al. 2017, Icarus 283:300): bolometric surface temperature in 0.5 degree bins by local time
factors.note: Mean of the measured surface temperature over one lunar day. A surface temperature: the Moon has no air. Null where the local-time coverage has gaps longer than half an hour. The polar targets in targets.json carry a different statistic (a modelled annual mean at 2 cm depth), so they differ from their cells.

factors.label: Day-night surface temperature range
factors.source: LRO Diviner Global Cumulative Products, PDS LRO-L-DLRE-5-GCP-V1.0 (Williams et al. 2017, Icarus 283:300): bolometric surface temperature in 0.5 degree bins by local time
factors.note: Highest minus lowest surface temperature over one lunar day (29.53 Earth days).

factors.label: Rock class
factors.source: Unified Geologic Map of the Moon, 1:5,000,000 (Fortezzo, Spudis and Harrel 2020, USGS), layer GeoUnits
factors.note: GLiM class codes as in earth.json, assigned from the map unit by the table in unitTable. The class with the largest area in the cell, if classed units cover at least 50% of it. Highland units are class 4 by the project's choice (anorthosite crust); crater units have no class.

factors.label: Permanently shadowed share
factors.source: LOLA maps of permanently shadowed regions LPSR_65S_240M_201608 and LPSR_65N_240M_201608 (NASA PDS Geosciences Node, LOLA archive extras; Mazarico et al. 2011, Icarus 211:1066)
factors.note: Where water ice can survive; the map shows shadow, not ice. The maps are complete only from 65 degrees latitude to each pole: cells that reach below 65 degrees are null, not zero.

notInFile.precip: No atmosphere, so no rain or snow: a fact, not missing data.
notInFile.windSpeed: No atmosphere, so no wind (0 m/s): a fact, not missing data.
notInFile.dustOpticalDepth: No atmosphere, so no dust suspended in air (0): a fact, not missing data. Dust lofted by landers or electrostatics is not covered.
